title: Simple Crochet Vest
description: A relaxed layering vest built from easy panels, light shaping, and tidy finishing.
expectationText: A first garment-style project that teaches panel construction, basic fit checks, and clean assembly without complex shaping.

steps.title: Measure and swatch
steps.instruction: Measure the chest you want to fit and make a small swatch so the vest width is predictable.

steps.title: Back panel
steps.instruction: Work the back panel in rows until it reaches the desired body length and armhole depth.

steps.title: Front panels
steps.instruction: Work two matching front panels, checking that they mirror the back length and shoulder width.

steps.title: Join the shoulders and sides
steps.instruction: Seam the shoulders first, then close the sides while leaving room for the armholes.

steps.title: Add edging
steps.instruction: Work a clean border around the neckline, armholes, and front opening to stabilize the shape.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in the ends and block lightly so the panels relax and the vest hangs evenly.
